summary: Regression testing passed for homepage, search, authenticated borrowing, return, stock-zero reservation, and mobile overflow. Production frontend build also passed.

minor.issue: Not deployed/configured in the frontend environment; real Sheets/Drive persistence, server authentication, stock mutation, and concurrent FIFO behavior remain unvalidated.

integration_issues.issue: REACT_APP_APPS_SCRIPT_URL is unset, so gasRequest returns null and all tested member activity uses local React state (MOCKED).

action_items: Deploy/configure the Google Apps Script /exec URL and retest catalog, auth, loan persistence, stock updates, and FIFO concurrency against Sheets/Drive.

Keep authenticated borrow flow explicitly reopening book detail after login if the intended UX is to continue the interrupted borrow; current behavior correctly closes both modals but does not automatically resume borrowing.
critical_code_review_comments: The visible catalog sync badge claims Google Sheets synchronization even when the Apps Script URL is absent and local hardcoded catalog/state is used; consider exposing an explicit mock/offline state.
seed_data_creation: None; only built-in local demo seed loan was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile UI regression passed. Login uses demo@unesa.ac.id / demo123 and is MOCKED. After unauthenticated borrow/login, the detail modal closes; reopen a book to complete authenticated borrow. Real Apps Script behavior is still untested.
rca of the issue: The configured frontend environment has no REACT_APP_APPS_SCRIPT_URL, and gasRequest intentionally returns null in that case. Therefore borrow/return/reserve state is only in-memory React state and cannot verify persistence or server-side business rules.
